items.stem: "I'm 95% sure this note is complete" is best treated as:

options.B: An internal estimate you may still verify
options.C: A promise that nothing is missing

items.stem: A weather-style "70% chance of rain" on a dry day most nearly means:

options.C: In many similar days, about 7 in 10 would see rain

items.stem: If ten similar emails were spam and this one scores high, the system is:

options.A: Estimating from patterns in similar cases

items.stem: Uncertainty remains in AI answers mainly because they:

options.B: Work from patterns, not perfect certainty
Estimates remove all doubt by design
options.C: Real inputs vary, and patterns do not cover every case

items.stem: An AI says "90% sure" and is wrong once. What is the fairest reading?

options.B: Percentages are meaningless in all tools
options.C: The score was an estimate, not a guarantee for this one case

items.stem: When stakes are high and the AI is "fairly sure," you should:

options.C: Add a human check on the claims that matter

items.stem: A single surprising miss most usefully tells you to:

options.B: Keep using judgment and allow for uncertainty
options.C: Trust the next score even more blindly

items.stem: A high confidence score should make you:

options.A: Still judge the stakes before you rely on it
options.C: Assume the AI has feelings about the topic
